CAR.head: This one sets up well for Carolina
CAR.body: Carolina has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Anything short of a win would be a surprise, though Vancouver can make a game of it if they get good looks.

VAN.head: A steep climb for Vancouver
VAN.body: Carolina has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Vancouver could still pull it off if they get good looks, but they might need a miracle.
